[[artifacts]]
source = "/srv/state/calls.jsonl"

args.evidence: Ryanair cancelled FR6211 AGP-BCN on 26 Oct for a part replacement; chargeback accepted.

args.message: Ryanair cancelled FR6211 AGP-BCN on 26 Oct for a part replacement; TripDesk accepted chargeback CB-R74 for EUR 164.00 on the carrier's failure.
EU261 Art 7: FR6211 AGP-BCN cancelled on the day for a technical fault, not extraordinary.
EU261 Art 9 care not given at AGP after the 26 Oct cancellation: meal receipt DOC-R74A.

args.summary: Ryanair refused the EUR 48 meal care claim DOC-R74A for FRR74A; care is owed after a cancellation whatever its cause.

args.message: Four passengers missed DL8411 BCN-LAX on 26 Oct after a separate Ryanair cancellation; they ask a no-show waiver.

args.text: I am sorry, this has been a long and frustrating trip. Your Mastercard dispute on the Ryanair ticket FRR74A was accepted, so the EUR 164 comes back through the card network. The EUR 1000 EU261 compensation (EUR 250 for each of the 4 passengers) has been claimed from Ryanair and has not been paid. The EUR 48 meal receipt DOC-R74A was claimed from Ryanair as care; it is unpaid, and I escalated it to supplier relations. The EUR 58 duty free receipt DOC-R74B is not claimed, since it is not care. Nothing is paid back for the night train DB-R74B: DB refunds nothing, since the train ran with no delay, and its cost is not claimed from Ryanair, since the Ryanair ticket already comes back through your card dispute. I asked Delta to waive the no-show on DLR74C, and no waiver has been granted.
